landing.heroSubheadline: GrainLedger records the mass flow from smallholder paddy fields to export containers on an append-only custody ledger — helping agribusinesses prove origin, clear MRL tests, and trace instantly.

corePromises.title: Three Pillars of the GrainLedger Custody Chain
corePromises.col1Desc: Every drying, milling, sorting, and blending step enforces conservation laws under strict tolerances. Unbalanced variances are rejected outright.
corePromises.col2Desc: When an adverse lab result occurs, trace forward to hold affected containers and trace backward to locate contributing farm plots.
corePromises.col3Desc: Full compliance engine for EU (EC 396/2005), US (EPA 40 CFR), Japan (MHLW Positive List), Korea, Codex, and Vietnam with conservative safety margins.

audiences.title: Who Does GrainLedger Serve?
audiences.millDesc: Provide contract drying, silo storage, milling, and bagging across multiple customer companies with audit-proof mass reconciliation.
audiences.customerDesc: Isolated multi-tenant custody of lots, direct farmer network monitoring, and blend plan simulation before container packing.
audiences.complianceDesc: Real-time MRL residue control per lot, instant HOLD locking upon risk detection, and automated compliance dossiers before customs clearance.

howItWorks.title: Mass Journey: 5 Closed Steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Weigh wet paddy at farm gate, measure moisture, seal representative samples, and record GPS coordinates offline.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Receive paddy at facility, dry down to 14% moisture, record accurate moisture loss, and store in silos by owner.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Fractionate into head rice, brokens, bran, and husks. Propagate processing factors and lineage mass proportions.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Algorithm calculates optimal blend formulas satisfying broken percentage, moisture, and chemical residues with safety margins.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Approve formulation, verify physical loading, lock tamper-evident bolt seals, and freeze immutable compliance dossiers.

landing.complianceNotice: GrainLedger strictly adheres to the Mass Balance chain-of-custody model defined in ISO 22095:2020. The platform accounts for mass proportions and does not make Identity-Preserved claims once grains are commingled in industrial silos.
landing.footer: Copyright © 2026 GFA26SE137 (FA26SE272). Developed for rice milling facilities in Tiền Giang, Vietnam.
